verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents built-in automations: auto-starting and auto-completing Epics, auto-creating Iterations, and rolling unfinished Stories forward. It also documents VCS integrations that update Shortcut as you work. These are preset automations, not a builder for custom trigger-and-action rules, and the REST API is only a developer building block that earns no credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rule builder with selectable triggers and actions, conditions or filters, documentation of rule setup and scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
